rows.comparator_pressure: not pointwise arbitrary, but consumes rank and needs explicit Jacobian or prior audit

rows.comparator_pressure: survives if Gamma,kappa are calibrated, shared, or constrained by additional carriers

rows.notes: A shared complex projection is not the same as arbitrary per-carrier freedom, but it can absorb enough structure that more carriers or a projection prior are required.

rows.comparator_pressure: none; each observed carrier is fit pointwise
rows.notes: Choosing Lambda_k=O_k/(G(z_k) F_k) absorbs the shared transfer law at each carrier. This is the conservative collapse boundary.

rows.comparator_pressure: runtime-worthy only if the projection manifold is finite and not equivalent to independent complex amplitudes

runtime_relevance_meaning.conditional: needs projection priors, more carriers, or a rank audit first
